questions.label: Locate the main conclusion
options: The society's investment portfolio includes a sizeable stake in fossil fuels.
The businesses it invests in have aims at odds with its own work.
The society is inconsistent in keeping these investments.
The society ought to sell its holdings in fossil-fuel businesses.
The society should take its lead from the two arts institutions mentioned.
optionsZh: 学会投资组合中包含相当数量的化石燃料企业股份。
学会投资的企业与它自身的研究目标存在冲突。
学会继续保有这类投资，显得言行不一。
学会应出售化石燃料企业的持股。
学会应以文中提到的两家艺术机构为榜样。

questions.label: Draw a conclusion from the evidence
options: People have overstated the extent of wolf attacks in this region.
A reported loss attributed to a wolf deserves investigation.
Farmers generally dislike the wolf's protected status.
Wolves do not deserve their reputation as sheep killers.
The compensation payments should end.
optionsZh: 人们夸大了当地狼袭击羊群的严重程度。
对于声称由狼造成的损失，应该审慎核实。
农场主普遍不赞成保护狼的政策。
狼不应有捕杀羊只的恶名。
应取消此项赔偿。

questions.label: Find an unstated assumption
options: Schools with and without a religious affiliation exist in similar numbers.
Many parents in this situation would have objected to the religious placement.
Religiously affiliated schools are much more common at secondary than primary level.
Only adults can make an informed choice about religion.
Most parents ask their children before ranking their school preferences.
optionsZh: 宗教学校和非宗教学校的数量相近。
处于这种情况的许多家长本来就不愿孩子进入宗教学校。
宗教中学的数量远多于宗教小学。
人只有成年后才能对宗教作出知情选择。
大多数家长填写学校志愿前会征求孩子的意见。

questions.label: Weigh new evidence against a claim
questions.labelZh: 评估新证据对论点的影响
options: Repeated use can make the medicine less effective for headaches.
Symptom relief makes people more likely to go back to work while contagious.
The studies on reducing fever used animals as their subjects.
Yearly vaccination is the most effective way to prevent flu.
A viral illness makes an unintended overdose more likely.
optionsZh: 反复使用这种药物可能使它缓解头痛的效果减弱。
症状缓解后，人们更可能在仍有传染性时回去工作。
关于退烧作用的研究使用的是动物实验对象。
每年接种疫苗是预防流感最有效的方式。
病毒感染时更可能意外服药过量。

questions.label: Spot an error in an inference
options: It relies on past generations being unaware of the risks of childbirth.
Its conclusion applies only to women in wealthy countries.
It overlooks a fall in the mortality rate among infants.
It treats early death as inevitable after several pregnancies.
It ignores other changes that could have extended women's lives.
optionsZh: 论证预设过去的人不了解生育的风险。
结论只涉及富裕国家的女性。
论证未提及婴儿死亡率下降。
它把多次妊娠后的早逝视作必然。
它忽略了同期其他可能延长女性寿命的变化。

questions.label: Match the logical form of two arguments
questions.labelZh: 比较两个论证的逻辑结构
options: An applicant seeking a top university place needs a special interest. A student seeks such a place, so she needs a special interest.
A parent seeking honest children should tell the truth. A parent often lies, so she cannot have that aim.
Persistent poor results trigger state intervention at a school. This school has had poor results for years, so intervention will follow.
Persistent lateness leads to dismissal. A worker is punctual, so his job is safe.
A future English student needs to read quickly. A pupil reads remarkably fast, so she must be aiming to study English.
optionsZh: 想进顶尖大学的申请人需要特长。一名学生想进这样的大学，所以她需要特长。
希望孩子诚实的家长应该说真话。一名家长经常撒谎，所以她不可能有那个目标。
成绩持续很差会导致学校受到政府干预。该校成绩连年很差，因此将受到干预。
经常迟到会被辞退。一名员工一向准时，因此工作有保障。
想在大学读英语的人需要读得快。一名学生读得特别快，所以她一定打算在大学读英语。

questions.label: Apply a principle to a new case
options: Heavy demand is no justification for a hotel to charge inflated prices.
Someone who was betrayed by a former partner is still wrong to tell lies about that partner.
A shop should not inflate prices to advertise a larger discount later.
People should avoid posting messages they would dislike seeing about themselves.
A player's criticism of a referee's error is justified only if the other side benefited.
optionsZh: 酒店不能以需求旺盛为由收取过高房费。
即使前任曾经背叛自己，对其散布谎言依然是错的。
商店不应先抬高价格，再借机宣传大幅折扣。
人们不应发布自己也不愿成为其对象的信息。
只有当裁判失误使对手获益时，球员批评这种失误才有正当理由。
